method: Built-in image_gen; style-reference generation and lighting-weather edits
scope: Six distinct belief category illustrations; day and night pairs. Three existing day subjects retained.

dayPrompts.church:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original editorial watercolor-and-graphite artwork for a Spanish Bible study website, one of six category illustrations.
Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its refined hand-drawn pencil lines, translucent watercolor, paper grain, gentle feathered edges and adult contemplative character; create a new scene, not a variation of its Bible and dove.
Style: sophisticated colored sketch on warm ivory paper, soft but present color, calm and intimate. Restrained deep petrol blue, muted sage, soft reddish sand and dusty rose/coral accents; warm balanced light without yellow or mustard cast.
Composition: horizontal 3:2, main subject readable in the central horizontal band so a 2:1 card crop keeps it intact. Artwork occupies about 75% with breathing room and softly dissolving edges. No border.
No text, lettering, logos, watermark, photography, 3D, cartoon style, harsh contrast or imitation of a named artist.
Primary subject: a small community of six adults of different ages sharing a quiet moment around a simple wooden table in an open Mediterranean courtyard shaded by an olive arbor. Warm gestures of listening and care, natural anatomy, modest everyday clothing, no dominant preacher. A small open Bible, a modest loaf of bread and a ceramic water pitcher on the table suggest fellowship, without becoming a still-life foreground. Faces are gently suggested with fine pencil detail. Make the people, table and interwoven branches the distinctive visual motif. Soft midmorning light.

nightPrompts.scriptures:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Image 1: edit target, the existing daytime watercolor illustration.
Primary request: create its dedicated night-mode companion for a calm Bible-reading website.
Preserve the subject, object count, geometry, framing, anatomy, pencil-and-watercolor medium, texture and feathered perimeter. Change only the environmental illumination and background-paper tone.
The Bible pages retain warm cream paper, clear abstract ink strokes, a gentle warm side light; the white dove has natural warm moonlit feathers and the olive leaves remain naturally green.
The paper and all outer margins become a deep warm charcoal blue-grey (#222729), softly continuous with the painted dark environment. Retain fine visible pencil work and translucent pigment; legible focal highlights and quiet presence. Use modest dusty rose/coral and reddish sand warmth to balance the deep petrol shadows. Natural colors, not a photographic negative, no inversion, no glowing neon foliage, no stark white rectangular paper or halo. Avoid flattening everything into darkness. No added objects, moon, lamps, text, logos or border. Same 3:2 landscape format.
